sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United face Alsager Town at home on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and have won seven of their ten matches overall, so they'll be heavy favourites against struggling Alsager, who are rooted to the foot of the league with just four points from ten games and sit on a run of one win in their last five.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday as they bid to keep pace with Sandbach; Stafford have 20 points and are also coming off a recent loss, so both leaders and challengers are looking to respond. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points, travel to Eccleshall in a mid-table clash, while fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a local fixture before potentially facing Brereton Social on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town visit Foley Meir in an encounter between mid-table sides, with both keen to build momentum. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a meeting of teams in the lower half, while Allscott Heath take on Crewe at home. Shawbury United are in freefall form—on a six-game losing streak—and face Barnton at home on Saturday. Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town, with both sides needing to arrest recent poor form; Widnes are pointless after seven games. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in the division's lowest-ranked fixture.
